issues.title: Canonical points to another domain
issues.why: This tells Google to index the other domain instead of yours.
issues.fix: Point the canonical to this page's own URL unless the cross-domain canonical is intentional.

issues.title: Sitemap lists URLs from a different domain
issues.why: Search engines ignore sitemap URLs that aren't on the site's own domain, so none of your pages are submitted.
issues.fix: Regenerate the sitemap so every <loc> uses this site's domain (realty.sailitup.com).

issues.title: Content only appears after JavaScript runs
issues.why: Google can render JavaScript but does it later and less reliably; Bing, AI search tools and social previews (WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Facebook) often see an empty page.
issues.fix: Serve pre-rendered HTML: enable server-side rendering or static pre-rendering in your framework/site builder, or use a pre-rendering service, so the raw HTML already contains the text, headings and links.

issues.title: Thin content (<250 words)
issues.why: Pages with little text rarely rank for competitive queries.
issues.fix: Expand with useful, original content (FAQs, details, examples) or noindex/merge low-value pages.

issues.title: Pages are set to noindex
issues.why: These pages are excluded from search results. Fine for private/thank-you pages, harmful otherwise.
issues.fix: Remove the 'noindex' robots meta tag / X-Robots-Tag header from pages that should rank.

issues.title: Title too long (>60 chars)
issues.why: Google truncates long titles, hiding your message.
issues.fix: Shorten titles to ≤60 characters, keeping the key phrase first.

details.https://realty.sailitup.com/demo: 81 chars: Live Demo | Sailitup Realty - Lead Management for Developers and Channel Partners

issues.title: Indexable pages missing from sitemap
issues.why: Pages absent from the sitemap may be discovered and recrawled more slowly.
issues.fix: Add these pages to your XML sitemap (or make sure the sitemap generator includes them).

issues.title: Meta description too short (<70 chars)
issues.why: Short descriptions under-use valuable search result space.
issues.fix: Expand to 120–160 characters describing the page's value.

issues.title: Title too short (<30 chars)
issues.why: Short titles miss the chance to target descriptive keywords.
issues.fix: Expand titles to 30–60 characters, e.g. '<Primary keyword> – <Benefit> | <Brand>'.

issues.title: Meta description too long (>160 chars)
issues.why: Long descriptions get truncated in search results.
